data.headline: Admission requirements
data.text:
Candidates should have a recognised first degree (Bachelor of Science or Engineering) in computer science, computer engineering, informatics or in another closely related discipline, awarded by an internationally recognised university or equivalent degree-awarding institution.

Applicants should also have a record of above-average performance during their undergraduate studies. Further, we strongly advise candidates to take the Graduate Record Examination (GRE).

Candidates are required to be able to speak and write fluent English (TOEFL 550 paper-based/213 computer-based/80 Internet-based or IELTS 6.0). English-speaking students will attend a basic German language course starting in August, 2 months prior to the beginning of the Master's programme.
